note: The version is the first x.y.z in the output of `codex --version`. The minimum is the version the recording ran (recorded/v.txt: codex-cli 0.165.0, the flags in expected-args.json were run on it). Older versions are not checked, so the minimum is the lowest version proved, not a judgment about older ones. A null version or a null minimum is unknown: unknown is allowed to run, and an unreadable transcript then says so.
